defs.def: a place where you can sit, for example a chair 座位，坐处（如椅子等）

ex.s: Dinner hours: Tuesday through Thursday 5:30 pm — 9:00 pm (last seating); Friday and Saturday 5:00 pm — 9:30 pm (last seating).
ex.t: 晚餐时间：周二至周四下午5:30—晚上9:00（最后入座）；周五、周六下午5:00—晚上9:30（最后入座）。

ex.s: But, in fact, I was on the edge of my seat!
ex.t: 但事实上，我坐在座位的边缘！

ex.s: It was then that I realised her seat was empty!
ex.t: 就在那时，我意识到她的座位是空的！

ex.s: It’s better to leave your listeners wishing for more than shifting restlessly in their seats waiting for your speech finally to end.
ex.t: 与其让你的听众焦躁不安地在座位上挪动、等着你的演讲终于结束，不如让他们意犹未尽。

ex.s: just two seats over，Andrew Mazoleny，a local videographer，is finishing his lunch at the bar.
ex.t: 只隔两个座位，当地摄像师安德鲁·马佐莱尼正在吧台吃完他的午餐。

ex.s: The vehicle — named the Transition – has two seats, four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这辆名为Transition的车有两个座位、四个轮子和可折叠的机翼，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.s: The vehicle-named the Transition – has two seats， four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这辆车——名为Transition——有两个座位、四个轮子和可折叠的机翼，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.t: 在网上分享这个故事后，有人联系我，他（7）_____那位女士是艾琳·史密斯。我（8）_____地打电话感谢她。她说她（9）_____我的钱包在公交车座位上。她（10）_____去陌生人家里是个（11）_____的举动，但她决定抓住机会。“如果我处在那种（12）_____。我会希望有人试着找到我，”她说。

ex.t: 14．（1分）只有当汽车停在我们家门前时，____我们才看到副驾驶座上的莉莉。（  ）

ex.s: Even soccer fans tend to have a seat each; gone are the days of thousands standing to watch the match.
ex.t: 就连足球迷也倾向于每人有一个座位；成千上万人站着观看比赛的日子一去不复返了。

ex.s: When Twain replied that he didn't, the barber told him that if he wanted to go to the event he would have to stand, as there were no seats left in the theatre.
ex.t: 当吐温回答没有时，理发师告诉他，如果他想去参加这个活动，他得站着，因为剧院里已经没有座位了。

ex.s: It reserves seats for the seniors.
ex.t: 它为老年人预留座位。

ex.s: You see much more from the seat of a bike!
ex.t: 坐在自行车上你能看到更多的风景！

defs.def: with the number of seats mentioned 构成名词和形容词
the part of a chair, etc. on which you actually sit （椅子等的）座部
a place where you pay to sit in a plane, train, theatre, etc. 座位
an official position as a member of a parliament, council, committee, etc. （议会、理事会、委员会等的）席位

ex.s: Before long I had won the first seat in the community orchestra …
ex.t: 不久我赢得了社区乐团的第一个席位...

ex.s: What enabled Tara to win the first seat in the community orchestra?
ex.t: 是什么让Tara赢得了社区乐团的第一个席位？

defs.def: a place where people are involved in a particular activity, especially a city that has a university or the offices of a government （尤指大学或政府机关）所在地；中心

ex.s: With an impressive 2,000-seat concert hall, St David’s Hall is home to the annual Welsh Proms Cardiff.
ex.t: 圣大卫音乐厅拥有令人印象深刻的2000座音乐厅，是每年加的夫威尔士逍遥音乐节的所在地。

defs.def: a large house in the country, that belongs to a member of the upper class （上层社会人士的）乡村宅第
the part of the body on which a person sits 臀部
the part of a pair of trousers/pants that covers a person's seat （裤子的）后裆，臀部

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 看到一辆停着的车车窗摇下、前座上有个___18___后，他在雨中守了约两小时，等___19___回来。

defs.def: to give sb a place to sit; to sit down in a place 向 … 提供座位；（使）就座；坐；落座

ex.s: Though the movie is 30 years old, most of the 250 seats were filled with teary-eyed audience wanting to say good-bye to the old building.
ex.t: 尽管这部电影已有30年历史，但250个座位几乎坐满了眼含泪水的观众，他们想向这座老建筑告别。

ex.s: Grandfather and Father, seated at the table, are playing chess.) Grandfather: And...I win!
ex.t: 坐在桌旁的爷爷和父亲正在下棋。）爷爷：还有……我赢了！

ex.s: Grandfather and Father, seated at the table, are playing chess.
ex.t: 坐在桌旁的爷爷和父亲正在下棋。

defs.def: to have enough seats for a particular number of people 可坐 … 人；能容纳 … 人

ex.s: As one group of workers carried out the rubbish, another group began removing seats and other theater equipment in preparation for the building’s end.
ex.t: 当一组工人运走垃圾时，另一组工人开始拆除座椅和其他剧院设备，为建筑的终结做准备。

ex.s: Rome’s Colosseum was 157 feet tall and had 80 entrances, seating 50,000 people.
ex.t: 罗马斗兽场高157英尺，有80个入口，可容纳5万人。
